done_when: sister_signals.py computes 4 states from Binance spot daily/weekly closes (perp first via binance_doh, spot fallback): PHASE2_ON (2 daily closes in 72,000-75,000), TOP_UP (daily close < 72,000 or price 65,000-67,000), STOP (weekly close < 60,000 or low < 57,800), CONFIRMED (weekly close > 80,500).
Thresholds live in sister_signals.json with source SISTER_NOTE_2026-11-07/09, labelled OURS; fixture tests: 11-07..11-09 closes give PHASE2_ON; a 71,900 daily close gives TOP_UP.
A state flip raises one SISTER toast + live log line once per flip (restart-safe state file, fails closed on data errors); the 07:00Z Monday SESSION BRIEF shows a SISTER: line with the current state.

Every Monday 07:00Z (and on each flip) it writes a draft WhatsApp note to F:/MTS/sister/ outside the repo: live prices, limit ladder (alts A -2%/B -5%, BTC A -1%/B -2%), the if/then block; never reads or writes her holdings.
Tests fail first on pre-change code, then pass; sync.py ship; deploy to the laptop live tree under d-dns-fix-deploy-standing-1109.
